headline: BlackRock Seeks to Protect Bitcoin Fund Investors From Losses After Rival Crash
summary: BlackRock is proposing a new Bitcoin fund structure designed to shield investors from steep losses, following similar downside protection products offered by Calamos.
why: BlackRock is the world's largest asset manager, expanding its range of digital asset investment vehicles to attract risk-conscious institutional clients.

impacts.name: BlackRock
impacts.why: Expanding specialized fund offerings helps capture broader capital inflows from risk-averse investors.
